data.description: 大教堂的加冕礼上，希斯特里亚接过王冠的瞬间抬起头，白色礼服与金色长发在大教堂的光柱中熠熠生辉，她深吸一口气——「从今天起，我不再是任何人手中的棋子。」
data.promptProse: Historia lifts her hands before the throne, her long blonde hair and white coronation gown lit by shafts of cathedral daylight. To her right, the silver-haired attendant in a dark burgundy ceremonial coat bends to lower the crown, his trimmed beard visible in profile.
data.title: 希斯特里亚 · 女王加冕
data.animaCaption: Long-haired blonde Historia raises both hands before the throne in a white coronation gown. A gray-haired attendant with a trimmed beard and a dark burgundy ceremonial coat lowers the crown from the right, his profile visible.
